name: Ankle rocks
instructions: Knee tracks over the toes, heel stays down.

name: Arm circles
instructions: Ten small circles forward, ten back, then widen them.

name: Band external rotation
instructions: Elbow pinned to your side, rotate the forearm outward. Light band.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Arms straight, pull the band to your chest, squeeze the shoulder blades.

name: Bird dog
instructions: Opposite arm and leg. Do not let the hips rotate.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Slow and full depth. Pause at the bottom.

name: Brisk walk / treadmill
instructions: Easy pace. You should still be able to talk.

name: Slow calf raise
instructions: Three seconds up, three down, full range.

name: Wall Calf Stretch
instructions: Face a wall, one foot forward, one back
Keep back leg straight, heel on ground
Lean into the wall
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it in the back of your lower leg

name: Cat-cow
instructions: On all fours, arch and round the spine with the breath.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees
Arch your back, looking up (cow)
Round your back, tucking chin (cat)
Move slowly between positions
You should feel it throughout your spine

name: Chest Doorway Stretch
instructions: Place your forearm against a wall or doorway
Step forward with the same-side leg
Turn your body away gently
Hold the stretch
You should feel it across your chest

name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel and sit back on your heels
Reach arms forward on the ground
Rest your forehead down
Breathe slowly and relax
You should feel it in your back and shoulders

name: Clamshell
instructions: On your side, knees bent, open the top knee without rolling back.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lower back stays flat on the floor throughout.

name: Easy stationary bike
instructions: Light resistance, steady cadence.

name: Easy rowing
instructions: Low stroke rate, focus on the leg drive.

name: Light face pull
instructions: Pull to the forehead, elbows high. Very light.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Squeeze at the top for a second. Ribs down.

name: Seated Figure-4 Glute Stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee
Gently press the crossed knee away
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it in your glute and hip

name: Hip circles
instructions: Hands on hips, big slow circles both directions.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee, other foot forward
Push your hips forward gently
Keep your back straight
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it in the front of your hip

name: Overhead Lat Stretch
instructions: Reach both arms overhead
Grab one wrist with the other hand
Lean to the side
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it along the side of your back

name: Leg swings (front to back)
instructions: Hold something. Ten swings per leg, relaxed.

name: Leg swings (side to side)
instructions: Ten per leg, keep the torso upright.

name: Marching in place
instructions: Drive the knees to hip height. No equipment needed.

name: Neck rotations
instructions: Slow, controlled, small range. Never force it.

name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand on one leg
Pull your other foot toward your glutes
Keep knees together
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it in the front of your thigh

name: Scapular push-up
instructions: Arms locked. Pinch the shoulder blades together, then push them apart.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
instructions: Sit with legs extended
Cross one leg over the other
Twist toward the bent knee
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it in your spine and hip

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Pull one arm across your chest
Use your other hand to gently press it closer
Keep shoulders down and relaxed
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it in the back of your shoulder

name: Shoulder pass-through
instructions: Wide grip on a band or stick, pass it overhead and behind. Widen the grip if it pinches.

name: Light skipping
instructions: Small hops, stay on the balls of your feet.

name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet together
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping back straight
Reach toward your toes
Hold the stretch, breathing slowly
You should feel it in the back of your thighs

name: Terminal knee extension
instructions: Band behind the knee, straighten the leg against it.

name: Thoracic rotation
instructions: Half-kneeling, hand behind the head, rotate the ribcage open.

name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
instructions: Reach one arm overhead
Bend at the elbow, hand behind your head
Use your other hand to gently pull the elbow
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides
You should feel it in the back of your upper arm

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Long stride, upright torso, controlled.

name: Wall slide
instructions: Back and arms flat to the wall, slide the arms overhead without losing contact.

name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: Deep lunge, elbow to the instep, then rotate the top arm to the ceiling.

name: Wrist circles and rocks
instructions: Circles both ways, then rock forward and back on your palms.
